    const current=++activation;wanted=!!on;enabled=false;emit();
    if(!wanted){try{localStorage.setItem('ma-sound','0')}catch(_){}return true;}
    unlocked=true;
    try{
      if(!prepare())throw new Error('Audio unavailable');
      context.onstatechange=()=>{enabled=wanted&&context.state==='running';emit();};
      if(context.state!=='running')await context.resume();
      if(current!==activation)return false;
      enabled=context.state==='running';
      if(enabled){try{localStorage.setItem('ma-sound','1')}catch(_){}}
      emit();return enabled;
    }catch(_){if(current===activation){wanted=false;enabled=false;emit();}return false;}
  }
  window.Sfx={
    get enabled(){return enabled},
    set,
    async toggle(){const on=!enabled;await set(on);this.force(enabled?'on':'off');return enabled},
    play(name,arg){if(name==='hover'&&!fine.matches)return;perform(name,arg,false)},
    force(name){if(name==='on'||name==='off')perform(name,undefined,true)},
    on(fn){listeners.add(fn);return ()=>listeners.delete(fn)}
  };
})();

/* Shared DOM and lifecycle helpers for homepage features. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const $=(s,root=document)=>root.querySelector(s);
  const all=(s,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll(s)];
  const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
  const escape=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));

  function lifetime(){const listeners=[],timers=new Set();return {listen(node,type,fn,opts){if(!node)return;node.addEventListener(type,fn,opts);listeners.push(()=>node.removeEventListener(type,fn,opts));},later(fn,ms){const id=setTimeout(()=>{timers.delete(id);fn()},ms);timers.add(id);return id;},cancel(id){clearTimeout(id);timers.delete(id)},clear(){timers.forEach(clearTimeout);timers.clear();listeners.splice(0).forEach(fn=>fn())}};}
  const sound=(name,arg)=>window.Sfx?.play(name,arg);
  window.PortfolioFeatureParts={$,all,clamp,escape,element,lifetime,sound};
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  const {$,all,clamp,escape,element,lifetime,sound}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  function createSoundUI(options,reduced){
    const life=lifetime(),sfx=window.Sfx;if(!sfx)return {destroy(){}};
    const host=options.soundMount||$('#top-nav .nav-inner')||$('#top-nav');if(!host)return {destroy(){}};
    const wrap=element('div','sound-control'),toggle=element('button','sound-toggle');toggle.type='button';toggle.dataset.soundToggle='';
    toggle.innerHTML='<span class="speaker" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="M3 8h3l4-4v12l-4-4H3zM13 7c2 1.4 2 4.6 0 6M15 4c4 3 4 9 0 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span><span data-sound-label></span>';
    wrap.append(toggle);host.insertBefore(wrap,$('#burger',host));
    let popover=null,remembered=false,promptSeen=false,destroyed=false,choosing=false;const label=$('[data-sound-label]',toggle);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','dialog');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    function dismiss(restore=false){if(popover){const leaving=popover;leaving.inert=true;leaving.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');leaving.removeAttribute('data-sound-consent');leaving.removeAttribute('id');if(reduced())leaving.remove();else{leaving.classList.add('closing');life.later(()=>leaving.remove(),160)}}popover=null;toggle.removeAttribute('aria-controls');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(restore)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});}
    function update(enabled){const state=String(enabled);if(toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed')===state)return;toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed',state);label.textContent='Sound '+(enabled?'on':'off');}
    update(sfx.enabled);const off=sfx.on(update);
    life.listen(toggle,'click',()=>{if(popover)dismiss();else showConsent(true)});
    try{remembered=localStorage.getItem('ma-sound-choice-v2')==='1'}catch(_){}
    async function choose(enabled){
      if(choosing)return;choosing=true;
      const panel=popover,restore=panel?.contains(document.activeElement);
      panel?.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
      const ready=await sfx.set(enabled);choosing=false;
      if(destroyed)return;
      panel?.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
      if(enabled&&!ready){const message=$('[data-sound-message]',panel);if(message)message.textContent='Sound could not start. Try Sound on again.';return;}
      if(enabled)sfx.force('on');remembered=true;
      try{localStorage.setItem('ma-sound-choice-v2','1')}catch(_){}
      dismiss(restore);
    }

      promptSeen=true;popover=element('div','sound-consent');popover.id='soundPreferences';popover.dataset.soundConsent='';popover.setAttribute('role','dialog');popover.setAttribute('aria-label','Page sound');
      popover.innerHTML='<p>A little sound?</p><span data-sound-message role="status">Soft clicks when you explore. Turn sound on for this visit.</span><div><button type="button" data-sound-enable>Sound on</button><button type="button" data-sound-decline>Sound off</button></div>';
      wrap.append(popover);toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls','soundPreferences');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');const on=$('[data-sound-enable]',popover),offButton=$('[data-sound-decline]',popover);on.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(sfx.enabled));offButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!sfx.enabled));life.listen(on,'click',()=>choose(true));life.listen(offButton,'click',()=>choose(false));if(fromControl)(sfx.enabled?on:offButton).focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    let previousOn=false;try{previousOn=localStorage.getItem('ma-sound')==='1'}catch(_){}
    if(!remembered||previousOn)life.later(()=>{if(!promptSeen&&!sfx.enabled)showConsent()},900);
    life.listen(document,'pointerdown',event=>{if(popover&&!wrap.contains(event.target))dismiss()});
    life.listen(document,'focusin',event=>{if(popover&&!wrap.contains(event.target))dismiss()});
    life.listen(document,'pointerover',event=>{const target=event.target.closest?.('a,button');if(target&&!target.contains(event.relatedTarget))sound('hover')});
    life.listen(document,'keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'&&popover){event.preventDefault();dismiss(popover.contains(document.activeElement))}});
    return {destroy(){destroyed=true;life.clear();off();wrap.remove()}};
  }
  Object.assign(window.PortfolioFeatureParts,{createSoundUI});
})();

/* Clipboard success is confirmed; restricted previews get a usable fallback. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const {$,element,lifetime}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  function createCopyUI(options){
    const life=lifetime(),host=options.copyMount||$('#footer .fd-bot nav'),email=options.data?.email;
    if(!host||!email)return {destroy(){}};
    const button=element('button','copy-email','Copy email'),status=element('span','feature-sr');
    const thanks=element('span','ola-thanks'),manual=element('div','copy-manual');
    const address=element('input','copy-address'),hint=element('p','copy-hint','Select and copy this address.');
    address.type='text';address.value=email;address.readOnly=true;address.setAttribute('aria-label','Email address to copy');
    address.setAttribute('autocomplete','off');address.setAttribute('spellcheck','false');
    manual.hidden=true;manual.append(address,hint);
    thanks.innerHTML='<span lang="pt">Obrigado!</span> <span class="ola-pronunciation">(oh-bree-GAH-doo)</span>';
    thanks.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    button.type='button';button.dataset.copyEmail='';status.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');status.setAttribute('aria-atomic','true');host.append(button,thanks,status,manual);
    let reset=null,generation=0,destroyed=false;
    function clearReceipt(){host.classList.remove('has-receipt');}
    function selectAddress(){address.focus({preventScroll:true});address.select?.();address.setSelectionRange?.(0,email.length);}
    // Compatibility path for embedded/file previews that reject Clipboard.writeText.
    // The browser still decides whether this user-initiated copy is permitted.
    function legacyCopy(){
      if(typeof document.execCommand!=='function')return false;
      const field=element('textarea','copy-buffer');field.value=email;field.readOnly=true;
      field.setAttribute('aria-label','Email address');document.body.append(field);
      try{field.focus({preventScroll:true});field.select();field.setSelectionRange(0,email.length);return document.execCommand('copy')===true;}
      catch(_){return false;}
      finally{field.remove();button.focus({preventScroll:true});}
    }
    life.listen(address,'click',selectAddress);
    life.listen(button,'click',async()=>{
      if(!manual.hidden){selectAddress();return;}
      const current=++generation;if(reset)life.cancel(reset);clearReceipt();status.textContent='';button.disabled=true;
      let copied=false;
      try{if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(email);copied=true;}}catch(_){}
      if(destroyed||current!==generation)return;
      button.disabled=false;
      if(!copied)copied=legacyCopy();
      if(copied){
        button.textContent='Copied';status.textContent='Email address copied. Obrigado! (oh-bree-GAH-doo)';host.classList.add('has-receipt');
        reset=life.later(()=>{button.textContent='Copy email';status.textContent='';clearReceipt()},4200);
      }else{
        button.textContent='Select email';manual.hidden=false;
        hint.textContent=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Press and hold the address to copy it.':'Press ⌘C or Ctrl+C to copy.';
        status.textContent='Automatic copying is blocked. The email address is selected for you.';selectAddress();
      }
    });
    return {destroy(){destroyed=true;generation++;life.clear();clearReceipt();button.remove();thanks.remove();status.remove();manual.remove()}};
  }
  window.PortfolioFeatureParts.createCopyUI=createCopyUI;
})();

/* A real voice, one accent hop and a one-time underline reveal. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const {$,lifetime}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  function createFooterDetails(options,reduced=()=>false){
    const footer=$('#footer'),button=$('.ola-voice'),audio=$('#olaRecording'),status=$('#olaVoiceStatus'),email=$('.ola-email');
    if(!footer||!button||!audio)return {destroy(){}};
    const life=lifetime();let sequence=0,destroyed=false,observer=null;
    function stop(){sequence++;audio.pause();button.classList.remove('voice-playing');button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');}
    life.listen(button,'click',async()=>{
      stop();const current=sequence;audio.currentTime=0;button.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');status.textContent='';
      try{
        await audio.play();
        if(destroyed||current!==sequence)return;
        if(!reduced()){void button.offsetWidth;button.classList.add('voice-playing');}
        status.textContent='Miguel says olá.';
      }catch(_){if(!destroyed&&current===sequence)status.textContent='The recording could not play. Tap olá to try again.';}
      finally{if(current===sequence)button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');}
    });
    life.listen(audio,'ended',()=>button.classList.remove('voice-playing'));
    life.listen(audio,'error',()=>{stop();status.textContent='The recording could not play. Tap olá to try again.'});
    life.listen(document,'visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stop()});
    life.listen(window,'pagehide',stop);
    function reveal(){footer.classList.add('footer-seen');observer?.disconnect();}
    if(email&&!reduced()&&typeof IntersectionObserver==='function'){
      footer.classList.add('footer-motion-ready');
      observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{if(entries.some(entry=>entry.isIntersecting))reveal()},{threshold:.6});
      observer.observe(email);
    }else reveal();
    return {motionChanged(){if(reduced()){button.classList.remove('voice-playing');reveal()}},destroy(){destroyed=true;stop();observer?.disconnect();life.clear();footer.classList.remove('footer-motion-ready','footer-seen')}};
  }
  window.PortfolioFeatureParts.createFooterDetails=createFooterDetails;
})();

/* Mar largo, adapted from Miguel's supplied footer. Keep canvas work local to the visible band. */
(function(){
'use strict';
const {$,lifetime}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
const Calcada = (() => {
  const INK = '#151515', PAPER = '#ece9e4', RED = '#c93a26';
  function layout(cols, rows){
    const cells = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++){
      const even = c % 2 === 0, top = r % 2 === 0;
      let corner, disc, bg;
      if (top){ if (even){ corner = 3; disc = INK; bg = PAPER; } else { corner = 0; disc = PAPER; bg = INK; } }
      else    { if (even){ corner = 2; disc = PAPER; bg = INK; } else { corner = 3; disc = PAPER; bg = INK; } }
      cells.push({ c, r, corner, disc, bg, f:0, lift:0, y:0, rad:1, wipe:0, wipeFrom:corner, flipped:false, hold:0, t0:0, phase:0, placed:1 });
    }
    return cells;
  }
  function markRed(cells, cols){
    const a = cells.find(x => x.r === 0 && x.c === 9 % cols) ; if (a){ a.disc = RED; a.red = true; }
    const bc = Math.max(1, Math.round(cols * .74)) | 1;
    const b = cells.find(x => x.r === 1 && x.c === bc); if (b){ b.disc = RED; b.red = true; }
  }
  const cornerXY = (k, s) => [[0,0],[s,0],[s,s],[0,s]][k];
  return { INK, PAPER, RED, layout, markRed, cornerXY };
})();

function createFooterStones(options,reduced=()=>false){
  const band=$('.ola-tiles'),cv=$('.ola-stones');
  let ctx;try{ctx=cv?.getContext('2d')}catch(_){}
  if(!band||!ctx)return {destroy(){}};
  const life=lifetime(),off=document.createElement('canvas'),octx=off.getContext('2d');
  if(!octx)return {destroy(){}};
  const HOLD=1100,FLIP=320,SLICE=2;
  let wave=null,raf=0,visible=false,destroyed=false,cooled=0,io=null,resize=null;
  const st={s:32,cols:0,rows:2,pad:0,x0:0,cells:[],w:0,h:0,dpr:1,last:null,reduce:reduced()};
  const B={stone};
  function build(){
    const r=band.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(r.width<=0||r.height<=0){
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;wave=null;st.w=0;st.h=0;st.cells=[];
      band.classList.remove('stones-ready');return;
    }
    st.dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
    st.s=Math.max(8,Math.round(r.height/2*st.dpr))/st.dpr;
    st.pad=Math.round(st.s*.5);st.x0=Math.round((st.s*.625-st.s*2)*st.dpr)/st.dpr;
    st.cols=Math.ceil((r.width-st.x0)/st.s)+1;
    st.cells=Calcada.layout(st.cols,st.rows);Calcada.markRed(st.cells,st.cols);
    st.w=r.width;st.h=st.s*2+st.pad*2;
    cv.style.top=-st.pad+'px';cv.style.height=st.h+'px';
    cv.width=Math.round(st.w*st.dpr);cv.height=Math.round(st.h*st.dpr);
    off.width=cv.width;off.height=Math.round(st.s*2*st.dpr);
    paint(performance.now());
    band.classList.add('stones-ready');
  }
  function paint(t){
    if(!st.w||!st.h||!off.width||!off.height)return;
    ctx.setTransform(st.dpr,0,0,st.dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,st.w,st.h);draw(ctx,st,t);
  }
  function active(t){return wave!==null||st.cells.some(c=>c.flipT&&(c.toward||t-c.flipT<FLIP));}
  function schedule(){if(!raf&&!destroyed&&visible&&!document.hidden&&!reduced())raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
  function frame(t){raf=0;if(destroyed||!visible||document.hidden||reduced())return;paint(t);if(active(t))schedule();}
  function stop(){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;wave=null;st.last=null;st.cells.forEach(c=>{c.flipT=0;c.flipped=false;c.toward=false});paint(performance.now());}
  function enter(){const t=performance.now();if(!reduced()&&t>cooled){cooled=t+5000;wave=t;schedule();}}
  function touch(c,t){
    if(c.flipT&&t-c.flipT<FLIP)return;
    if(c.flipped){c.hold=t+HOLD;return;}
    c.flipT=t;c.toward=true;c.hold=t+FLIP+HOLD;
  }
  function trail(e){
    if(reduced()||document.hidden)return;
    const rect=band.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-rect.left,y=e.clientY-rect.top,p=st.last;
    st.last={x,y};const n=p?Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(x-p.x,y-p.y)/(st.s/3))):1,seen=new Set(),t=performance.now();
    for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){
      const px=p?p.x+(x-p.x)*i/n:x,py=p?p.y+(y-p.y)*i/n:y;
      const c=Math.floor((px-st.x0)/st.s),r=Math.floor(py/st.s);
      if(c<0||c>=st.cols||r<0||r>=st.rows)continue;
      const cell=st.cells[r*st.cols+c];if(!seen.has(cell)){seen.add(cell);touch(cell,t);}
    }
    schedule();
  }
  life.listen(band,'pointermove',trail,{passive:true});
  life.listen(band,'pointerdown',e=>{st.last=null;trail(e)},{passive:true});
  life.listen(band,'pointerleave',()=>{st.last=null});
  life.listen(band,'pointercancel',()=>{st.last=null});
  life.listen(band,'pointerup',e=>{if(e.pointerType!=='mouse')st.last=null});
  life.listen(document,'visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stop();else if(visible)enter()});
  life.listen(window,'pagehide',stop);
  build();

  if(typeof IntersectionObserver==='function'){
    io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{for(const en of entries){visible=en.isIntersecting;if(visible)enter();else stop()}},{threshold:.9});io.observe(band);
  }else{visible=true;enter()}
  return {motionChanged(){st.reduce=reduced();if(st.reduce)stop();else if(visible)enter()},destroy(){destroyed=true;stop();io?.disconnect();resize?.disconnect();life.clear();band.classList.remove('stones-ready')}};
  function stone(ctx, x, y, s, k, bg, disc, o = {}){
    ctx.save();
    if (o.sy !== undefined && o.sy !== 1){ ctx.translate(0, y + s / 2); ctx.scale(1, Math.max(.001, o.sy)); ctx.translate(0, -(y + s / 2)); }
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x, y, s, s); ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
    const [cx, cy] = Calcada.cornerXY(k, s);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + cx, y + cy); ctx.arc(x + cx, y + cy, Math.max(0, s * (o.rad ?? 1)), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = disc; ctx.fill();
    if (o.wipe > 0){
      const [wx, wy] = Calcada.cornerXY(o.wipeFrom ?? k, s);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + wx, y + wy, s * 1.45 * o.wipe, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = disc; ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + cx, y + cy); ctx.arc(x + cx, y + cy, Math.max(0, s * (o.rad ?? 1)), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fill();
    }
    if (o.shade){ ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(21,21,21,${o.shade})`; ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s); }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function draw(ctx, st, t){
      const s = st.s;
      /* 1. lay the stones flat on an offscreen street */
      octx.setTransform(st.dpr, 0, 0, st.dpr, 0, 0);
      octx.clearRect(0, 0, st.w, s * st.rows);
      for (const c of st.cells){
        const x = st.x0 + c.c * s, y = c.r * s;
        let sy = 1, inv = !!c.flipped, shade = 0;
        if (c.flipT){
          const p = (t - c.flipT) / FLIP;
          if (p < 1 && !st.reduce){ sy = Math.abs(Math.cos(Math.PI * p)); inv = p < .5 ? !c.toward : c.toward; shade = (1 - sy) * .2; }
          else { c.flipped = c.toward; inv = c.flipped; if (c.flipped && t > c.hold){ c.flipT = t; c.toward = false; } }
        }
        const bg = inv ? c.disc : c.bg, disc = inv ? c.bg : c.disc;
        if (sy < 1){ octx.fillStyle = Calcada.PAPER; octx.fillRect(x, y, s, s); }
        B.stone(octx, x, y, s, c.corner, bg, disc, { sy, shade });
      }
      /* 2. the swell: draw the street in thin vertical slices, each lifted by a smooth damped wave */
      const H = s * st.rows;
      if (!wave){ ctx.drawImage(off, 0, 0, off.width, off.height, 0, st.pad, st.w, H); return; }
      const sweep = st.w / 2.1, k = st.dpr;
      for (let x = 0; x < st.w; x += SLICE){
        const lt = (t - wave) / 1000 - x / sweep;
        let dy = 0;
        if (lt > 0){ const env = Math.exp(-lt / .8); dy = -.55 * s * env * Math.sin(lt * Math.PI * 2 / 1.3); }
        ctx.drawImage(off, Math.round(x * k), 0, Math.ceil(SLICE * k), off.height, x, st.pad + dy, SLICE + .5, H);
      }
      if (t - wave > 2100 + 5200) wave = null;
    }
}
window.PortfolioFeatureParts.createFooterStones=createFooterStones;
})();

/* Keep the last painted preview alive until the lens has finished returning to the portrait. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function createLensMotion({portal,layers,reduced,onChange}){
    let selected=-1,timer=0,revision=0,order=0;
    const visible=new Set();
    function settle(){
      clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;
      layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{const keep=index===selected;layer.classList.toggle('show',keep);layer.classList.remove('retained');layer.style.zIndex=keep?'1':'0';if(!keep)visible.delete(index)});
      order=1;onChange();
    }
    function select(index){
      if(index===selected)return;
      const current=++revision;clearTimeout(timer);selected=index;
      portal.classList.toggle('on',index>=0);portal.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(index<0));
      if(index>=0){
        const returning=layers[index].classList.contains('retained');
        const depth=Number(layers[index].style.zIndex)||0;
        layers.forEach((layer,i)=>{
          if(returning&&Number(layer.style.zIndex)>depth)layer.classList.remove('retained');
          else if(layer.classList.contains('show')&&i!==index)layer.classList.add('retained');
          layer.classList.toggle('show',i===index);
        });
        // Reverse the upper layer's fade instead of lifting an opaque old layer over it.
        visible.add(index);if(!returning)layers[index].style.zIndex=String(++order);
      }
      // Opening fades only the parent: no simultaneous child fade, resize or mask collapse.
      onChange();
      if(reduced())settle();else timer=setTimeout(()=>{if(current===revision)settle()},560);
    }
    return {select,playing:index=>visible.has(index),motionChanged(){if(reduced())settle()},destroy(){clearTimeout(timer);visible.clear()}};
  }
  window.PortfolioFeatureParts.createLensMotion=createLensMotion;
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  const {$,all,clamp,escape,element,lifetime,sound}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  function enhanceDial(options,products,reduced){
    const life=lifetime(),root=options.dial||$('#heroDial');if(!root)return {destroy(){},motionChanged(){}};
    const buttons=all('button',root);if(!buttons.length)return {destroy(){},motionChanged(){}};
    let selected=clamp(options.initialProject??2,0,buttons.length-1),peek=selected,pending=[],drag=null,lastWheel=-Infinity,hoverTimer=0;
    const choices=options.focusChoices||products;
    const fine=matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)');
    root.setAttribute('role','radiogroup');root.setAttribute('aria-label','Change focus');root.classList.add('focus-ring-dial');
    const live=element('span','feature-sr');live.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');live.setAttribute('aria-atomic','true');root.append(live);
    function clearHover(){if(hoverTimer)life.cancel(hoverTimer);hoverTimer=0;}
    function cancel(){pending.forEach(id=>life.cancel(id));pending=[];}
    function currentTop(index){const button=buttons[index];return button.offsetTop+button.offsetHeight/2||index*44;}
    function update(index,commit,source,force=false){index=clamp(index,0,buttons.length-1);if(commit)selected=index;if(index===peek&&!force)return;const previous=peek;peek=index;buttons.forEach((button,i)=>{button.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(i===index));button.tabIndex=i===index?0:-1;button.removeAttribute('aria-pressed')});live.textContent='Focused on '+(choices[index]?.name||buttons[index].textContent.trim());options.selectProject?.(index,{commit,source});cancel();if(source==='initial'||source==='hover-return')return;
      const count=Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.abs(currentTop(index)-currentTop(previous))/10));
      if(reduced()){sound('detent');return}
      for(let k=1;k<=count;k++){const at=600*(1-Math.pow(1-k/count,1/3))*.55;pending.push(life.later(()=>sound('detent'),at))}
    }
    buttons.forEach((button,index)=>{button.setAttribute('role','radio');button.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(index===selected));button.tabIndex=index===selected?0:-1;button.removeAttribute('aria-pressed');
      life.listen(button,'click',event=>{clearHover();if(drag?.moved){event.preventDefault();return}update(index,true,'click',true)});
      life.listen(button,'focus',()=>update(index,true,'focus'));
      life.listen(button,'pointerenter',()=>{clearHover();if(fine.matches&&!drag)hoverTimer=life.later(()=>update(index,false,'hover'),70)});
      life.listen(button,'pointerleave',clearHover);
    });
    life.listen(root,'keydown',event=>{clearHover();const keys={ArrowDown:1,ArrowRight:1,ArrowUp:-1,ArrowLeft:-1};let next;if(keys[event.key])next=(peek+keys[event.key]+buttons.length)%buttons.length;else if(event.key==='Home')next=0;else if(event.key==='End')next=buttons.length-1;else return;event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();update(next,true,'keyboard');buttons[next].focus({preventScroll:true});});
    life.listen(root,'pointerleave',()=>{clearHover();if(fine.matches&&!drag)hoverTimer=life.later(()=>update(selected,false,'hover-return'),100)});
    life.listen(root,'wheel',event=>{if(Math.abs(event.deltaY)<Math.abs(event.deltaX)||Math.abs(event.deltaY)<2)return;clearHover();event.preventDefault();const now=performance.now();if(now-lastWheel<260)return;lastWheel=now;update((peek+(event.deltaY>0?1:-1)+buttons.length)%buttons.length,true,'wheel')},{passive:false});
    life.listen(root,'pointerdown',event=>{clearHover();if(drag||event.button>0||event.isPrimary===false)return;drag={y:event.clientY,start:peek,pointer:event.pointerId,moved:false};});
    life.listen(document,'pointermove',event=>{if(!drag||drag.pointer!==event.pointerId)return;const delta=event.clientY-drag.y;if(Math.abs(delta)<8&&!drag.moved)return;drag.moved=true;root.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);if(event.cancelable)event.preventDefault();const height=buttons[0].offsetHeight||44;update(clamp(drag.start+Math.round(delta/height),0,buttons.length-1),true,'drag')});
    life.listen(document,'pointerup',()=>{if(drag?.moved)life.later(()=>{drag=null},0);else drag=null});life.listen(document,'pointercancel',()=>{drag=null});
    live.textContent='Focused on '+(choices[selected]?.name||buttons[selected].textContent.trim());
    return {sync(index){cancel();selected=peek=clamp(index,0,buttons.length-1);buttons.forEach((button,i)=>{button.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(i===peek));button.tabIndex=i===peek?0:-1;button.removeAttribute('aria-pressed')});live.textContent='Focused on '+(choices[peek]?.name||buttons[peek].textContent.trim())},motionChanged(){if(reduced())cancel()},destroy(){cancel();life.clear();live.remove()}};
  }
  Object.assign(window.PortfolioFeatureParts,{enhanceDial});
})();

/* Public integration boundary. Load feature modules before initializing. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const {$,all,clamp,escape,element,lifetime,sound}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  const {createSoundUI,createCopyUI,createFooterDetails,createFooterStones,createBay,enhanceDial}=window.PortfolioFeatureParts;
  function makeProducts(options){
    const definitions=[['Survey creation','Better questions. Clearer answers.','#233171','#233171'],['Writing','Your words, another way.','#254d3a','#eef0e5'],['Reading','A quieter place to read.','#d3dccf','#d3dccf'],['Art discovery','Find art that stays with you.','#151515','#f6f4ee']];
    return (options.data?.projects||[]).slice(0,4).map((p,index)=>{
      const custom=(options.products||[]).find(x=>x.id===p.id)||{},d=definitions[index];
      return {...p,index,category:d[0],tagline:d[1],shell:d[2],screenBg:d[3],url:p.live,caseHref:'#case/'+p.id,embeddable:false,...custom,url:custom.url||custom.live||p.live};
    });
  }
  let activeInstance=null;
  window.PortfolioFeatures={init(options){activeInstance?.destroy();const life=lifetime(),motion=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'),reduced=()=>motion.matches||!!options.reducedOrPaused?.(),products=makeProducts(options);
    const copy=createCopyUI(options,reduced),footer=createFooterDetails(options,reduced),stones=createFooterStones(options,reduced),soundUI=createSoundUI(options,reduced),dial=enhanceDial(options,products,reduced),bay=options.console===true&&typeof createBay==='function'?createBay({...options,selectProject(index,details){dial.sync?.(index);options.selectProject?.(index,details)}},products,reduced):null;
    const parts=[copy,footer,stones,soundUI,dial,bay].filter(Boolean);const motionChanged=()=>{document.body.classList.toggle('features-still',reduced());parts.forEach(part=>part.motionChanged?.())};life.listen(motion,'change',motionChanged);motionChanged();
    const instance={motionChanged,destroy(){parts.forEach(part=>part.destroy());life.clear();if(activeInstance===instance)activeInstance=null}};activeInstance=instance;return instance;
  }};
})();

/* Collapse navigation when its actual content no longer fits, including enlarged text. */
(()=>{
 const nav=document.querySelector('#top-nav'),inner=nav?.querySelector('.nav-inner');if(!inner)return;
 let scheduled=0;
 function layout(){scheduled=0;nav.classList.remove('nav-compact');const children=[...inner.children].filter(e=>getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none');const gap=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(inner).columnGap)||0;const required=children.reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.max(e.scrollWidth,e.getBoundingClientRect().width),0)+gap*Math.max(0,children.length-1);if(required>inner.clientWidth+1)nav.classList.add('nav-compact');const height=Math.ceil(nav.getBoundingClientRect().height);document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height',height+'px');}
 function schedule(){if(!scheduled)scheduled=requestAnimationFrame(layout)}
 new ResizeObserver(schedule).observe(inner);const changes=new MutationObserver(layout);for(const e of inner.querySelectorAll('.brand,.links'))changes.observe(e,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style']});window.addEventListener('resize',schedule);document.fonts?.ready.then(schedule);layout();
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';
  const $ = (s,c=document) => c.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s,c=document) => [...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
  const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const body=document.body, motion=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reduce=motion.matches, paused=false, menuOpen=false, featureInstance=null;
  const data=JSON.parse($('#portfolio-data').textContent);
  const projects=data.projects, studies=data.studies;
  const mediaStates=new Map();
  const dialog=$('#cs'), scroller=$('#csScroll'), content=$('#csIn');
  let activeCase=-1, lastFocus=null, selectedProject=-1, peekProject=-1,lensMotion=null;
  const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const reducedOrPaused=()=>reduce||paused;

  /* Recorded product media. Direct actions remain independent of autoplay. */
  function permitted(state){
    return state.visible&&!state.root.closest('[inert]')&&!document.hidden&&!reducedOrPaused()&&!state.failed&&
      (state.surface==='case'?dialog.open:!dialog.open)&&
      (state.surface!=='portal'||(lensMotion?lensMotion.playing(state.index):state.index===peekProject));
  }
  function updateMedia(state){
    if(!state.root.isConnected)return;
    if(state.frame){state.frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'portfolio-playback',playing:permitted(state)},'*');return;}
    const play=permitted(state);state.version++;
    const version=state.version;
    if(!play){state.video.pause();return;}
    if(!state.video.getAttribute('src'))state.video.src=projects[state.index].video;
    const promise=state.video.play();
    if(promise)promise.then(()=>{if(version===state.version&&!permitted(state))state.video.pause();}).catch(error=>{
      if(error.name!=='AbortError'&&error.name!=='NotAllowedError')state.failed=true;
      if(version===state.version){state.root.dataset.playing='false';}
    });
  }
  function syncMedia(){mediaStates.forEach(updateMedia);}
  const mediaObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{
    const state=mediaStates.get(entry.target);if(!state)return;
    state.visible=entry.isIntersecting;updateMedia(state);
  }),{rootMargin:'80px',threshold:0});
  function makeMedia(index,surface){
    const p=projects[index], root=document.createElement('div');root.className='media-screen';root.dataset.project=p.id;root.style.setProperty('--media-bg',p.background);
    const image=document.createElement('img');image.src=p.poster;image.alt='';image.decoding='async';root.append(image);
    if(data.previews[p.id]){
      const frame=document.createElement('iframe');frame.title=p.name+' animated preview';frame.tabIndex=-1;frame.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');frame.setAttribute('sandbox','allow-scripts');
      frame.srcdoc=data.previews[p.id].replace("location.hash==='#lens'",surface==='portal'?'true':'false');root.append(frame);
      const state={root,frame,index,surface,visible:surface==='portal',failed:false,version:0};mediaStates.set(root,state);
      frame.addEventListener('load',()=>{root.dataset.ready='true';updateMedia(state)});return root;
    }
    const video=document.createElement('video');video.autoplay=true;video.setAttribute('autoplay','');video.muted=true;video.defaultMuted=true;video.loop=true;video.playsInline=true;video.preload='metadata';video.setAttribute('muted','');video.setAttribute('playsinline','');video.setAttribute('loop','');video.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');video.tabIndex=-1;video.poster=p.poster;root.append(video);
    const state={root,video,index,surface,visible:surface==='portal',failed:false,version:0};mediaStates.set(root,state);
    video.addEventListener('playing',()=>{if(permitted(state))root.dataset.playing='true';else video.pause();});
    video.addEventListener('error',()=>{state.failed=true;root.dataset.playing='false';});
    image.addEventListener('error',()=>{image.hidden=true;const note=document.createElement('p');note.className='media-fallback';note.textContent=p.name+' — open the project below.';root.append(note);},{once:true});
    return root;
  }
  function mountMedia(parent,index,surface){const root=makeMedia(index,surface);parent.append(root);mediaObserver.observe(root);return root;}
  function unmountMedia(root){const state=mediaStates.get(root);if(!state)return;state.failed=true;state.version++;if(state.video){state.video.pause();state.video.removeAttribute('src');state.video.load();}if(state.frame)state.frame.remove();mediaObserver.unobserve(root);mediaStates.delete(root);root.remove();}
  function clearCaseMedia(){mediaStates.forEach((state,root)=>{if(state.surface==='case')unmountMedia(root);});}
  $$('.card').forEach((card,index)=>{
    const frame=$('.frame',card),link=$('.media-link',frame);frame.replaceChildren();mountMedia(frame,index,'card');frame.append(link);
  });
  $$('.pv').forEach((el,index)=>mountMedia(el,index,'portal'));
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',syncMedia);
  document.addEventListener('portfolio:layoutchange',syncMedia);
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',syncMedia,{passive:true});
  addEventListener('pagehide',()=>mediaStates.forEach(s=>{if(s.video)s.video.pause();if(s.frame)s.frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'portfolio-playback',playing:false},'*');}));
  addEventListener('pageshow',syncMedia);

  /* Navigation: a compact disclosure with Escape and outside dismissal. */
  const nav=$('#top-nav'), burger=$('#burger'), menu=$('#mmenu');
  function setMenu(open,restore=false){
    menuOpen=open;menu.classList.toggle('open',open);menu.inert=!open;
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));burger.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close menu':'Open menu');
    if(open)nav.classList.remove('hide');if(restore)burger.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  setMenu(false);
  burger.addEventListener('click',()=>setMenu(!menuOpen));
  menu.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('a'))setMenu(false);});
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(menuOpen&&!menu.contains(e.target)&&!burger.contains(e.target))setMenu(false);});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&menuOpen){e.preventDefault();setMenu(false,true);}});
  document.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{if(menuOpen&&!menu.contains(e.target)&&!burger.contains(e.target))setMenu(false);});

  /* Lens retains its existing alignment with the portrait. */
  const hero=$('#hero'), portal=$('#portal'), dial=$('#heroDial'), buttons=$$('button',dial), marker=$('#heroMarker');
  function positionMarker(){const button=buttons[peekProject+1];if(button)marker.style.transform='translateY('+(button.offsetTop+button.offsetHeight/2-1.5)+'px)';}
  function showProject(index){
    peekProject=index;lensMotion.select(index);
    buttons.forEach((button,i)=>{button.classList.toggle('peek',i===index+1);button.classList.toggle('act',i===selectedProject+1);});
    positionMarker();syncMedia();
  }
  lensMotion=window.PortfolioFeatureParts.createLensMotion({portal,layers:$$('.pv'),reduced:reducedOrPaused,onChange:syncMedia});
  showProject(selectedProject);
  const headline=$('#headline');headline.setAttribute('aria-label',headline.textContent);
  headline.innerHTML=headline.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).map(w=>'<span class="w" aria-hidden="true">'+esc(w)+'</span>').join(' ');

  /* Reference case layout and transitions, with native dialog focus containment. */
  let caseRevision=0, casePhase='closed', caseIO=null;
  function originFor(index){return index===0?$('#xpPh'):$('.frame',$$('.card')[index-1]);}
  function insetOf(el){
    const r=el?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(!r||r.bottom<0||r.top>innerHeight)return 'inset('+(innerHeight*.3)+'px '+(innerWidth*.3)+'px '+(innerHeight*.3)+'px '+(innerWidth*.3)+'px round 14px)';
    return 'inset('+Math.max(0,r.top).toFixed(1)+'px '+Math.max(0,innerWidth-r.right).toFixed(1)+'px '+Math.max(0,innerHeight-r.bottom).toFixed(1)+'px '+Math.max(0,r.left).toFixed(1)+'px round 12px)';
  }
  const caseStill=()=>reducedOrPaused()||dialog.classList.contains('instant');
  function caseInput(e){dialog.classList.toggle('instant',e.detail===0);}
  function renderCase(index){
    caseIO?.disconnect();clearCaseMedia();activeCase=index;const c=studies[index],next=(index+1)%studies.length;
    dialog.style.setProperty('--c1',c.palette[0]);dialog.style.setProperty('--c2',c.palette[1]);dialog.style.setProperty('--c3',c.palette[2]);
    const title=esc(c.shortName);
    const visual=c.project===null?'<div class="cs-vis ph" id="csVis"><span class="xp-in"><img src="'+esc(data.f24Image)+'" alt="The F24 team watching a presentation at the hackathon"></span></div>':'<div class="cs-vis scr43" id="csVis"></div>';
    const actions=c.live?'<div class="cs-actions cs-fade" style="--d:3"><a class="btn-cs" href="'+esc(c.live)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open '+esc(c.shortName)+' <i aria-hidden="true">→</i></a></div>':'';
    content.innerHTML='<header class="cs-hero"><a class="cs-kind cs-back cs-fade" id="csBack" href="#top" style="--d:0">Back to home</a><h2 class="cs-title" id="csTitle" aria-label="'+esc(c.shortName)+'">'+title+'</h2><div class="cs-side"><p class="cs-tags cs-fade" style="--d:1">'+esc(c.summary)+'</p><p class="cs-lead cs-fade" style="--d:2">'+esc(c.ownership)+'</p>'+(c.meta.length?'<dl class="cs-meta cs-fade" style="--d:3">'+c.meta.map(m=>'<dt>'+esc(m[0])+'</dt><dd>'+esc(m[1])+'</dd>').join('')+'</dl>':'')+actions+'</div></header>'+
      '<div class="cs-vwrap cs-fade" style="--d:4">'+visual+'<p class="cs-cap">'+esc(c.project===null?'F24 hackathon.':c.caption)+'</p></div>'+
      (c.stats?'<div class="cs-stats">'+c.stats.map(stat=>'<div class="cr"><b>'+esc(stat[0])+'</b><span>'+esc(stat[1])+'</span></div>').join('')+'</div>':'')+
      '<section class="cs-sec"><h3 class="cr">'+esc(c.heading)+'</h3><div class="cs-stack">'+c.sections.map(section=>'<article class="cs-card"><div class="cbody"><h4>'+esc(section[0])+'</h4><p>'+esc(section[1])+'</p></div></article>').join('')+'</div></section><div class="cs-end cr">'+(c.end?'<p>'+esc(c.end)+'</p>':'')+'<a class="btn-cs" href="#footer" id="csContact">Ask about this project <i aria-hidden="true">→</i></a></div><button class="cs-next" type="button" id="csNext"><small>Next case study</small><b>'+esc(studies[next].shortName)+' <i aria-hidden="true">→</i></b></button>';
    if(c.project!==null)mountMedia($('#csVis'),c.project,'case');
    $('#csBack').addEventListener('click',returnHome);
    $('#csNext').addEventListener('click',e=>{caseInput(e);switchCase(next);});
    $('#csContact').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();caseInput(e);closeCase(false,()=>{$('#frMail').focus({preventScroll:true});},'#footer');});
    caseIO=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('in');caseIO.unobserve(entry.target);}}),{root:scroller,threshold:.15});
    $$('.cr',content).forEach(el=>reducedOrPaused()?el.classList.add('in'):caseIO.observe(el));
    scroller.scrollTop=0;
  }
  function openCase(index,trigger,instant=false){
    if(!studies[index]||typeof dialog.showModal!=='function')return false;
    dialog.classList.toggle('instant',instant);const revision=++caseRevision;casePhase='opening';setMenu(false);lastFocus=trigger||document.activeElement;
    dialog.classList.remove('shown','swap','preparing');renderCase(index);dialog.style.opacity='1';dialog.style.transform='none';dialog.style.transition='none';dialog.style.clipPath=caseStill()?'none':insetOf(originFor(index));
    if(!dialog.open)dialog.showModal();dialog.classList.add('open');body.style.overflow='hidden';void dialog.offsetWidth;
    if(!caseStill()){dialog.style.transition='clip-path 720ms cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1),background-color 320ms ease';dialog.style.clipPath='inset(0px 0px 0px 0px round 0px)';}
    syncMedia();if(trigger)window.Sfx?.play('paper');
    setTimeout(()=>{if(revision!==caseRevision||!dialog.open)return;casePhase='open';dialog.classList.add('shown');$('#csClose').focus({preventScroll:true});},caseStill()?0:120);return true;
  }
  function closeCase(restore=true,after,destination){
    if(!dialog.open||casePhase==='closing')return;
    const revision=++caseRevision;casePhase='closing';dialog.classList.remove('swap','preparing');
    if(destination)$(destination)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant'});
    if(!caseStill()){dialog.style.transition=destination?'opacity 360ms ease,transform 440ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)':'clip-path 560ms cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1),opacity 240ms 280ms ease';dialog.style.opacity='0';if(destination)dialog.style.transform='translateY(12px)';else dialog.style.clipPath=insetOf(originFor(activeCase));}
    window.Sfx?.play('whoosh');
    setTimeout(()=>{if(revision!==caseRevision)return;dialog.close();cleanupCase();if(after)after();else if(restore&&lastFocus?.isConnected)lastFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});},caseStill()?0:(destination?440:560));
  }
  function switchCase(index){
    if(casePhase==='closing'||casePhase==='swapping')return;
    const revision=++caseRevision;casePhase='swapping';dialog.classList.add('swap');dialog.classList.remove('shown');
    setTimeout(()=>{if(revision!==caseRevision||!dialog.open)return;dialog.classList.add('preparing');renderCase(index);dialog.classList.remove('swap');void content.offsetWidth;$('#csClose').focus({preventScroll:true});requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(revision===caseRevision&&dialog.open){casePhase='open';dialog.classList.remove('preparing');dialog.classList.add('shown');}}));},caseStill()?0:200);
  }
  function cleanupCase(){caseIO?.disconnect();casePhase='closed';dialog.classList.remove('open','shown','swap','preparing','instant');dialog.style.transition='none';dialog.style.opacity='1';dialog.style.transform='none';dialog.style.clipPath='none';body.style.overflow='';clearCaseMedia();content.replaceChildren();activeCase=-1;syncMedia();}
  dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{if(!dialog.open)cleanupCase();});
  dialog.addEventListener('cancel',e=>{e.preventDefault();dialog.classList.add('instant');closeCase();});
  $('#csClose').addEventListener('click',e=>{caseInput(e);closeCase();});
  function returnHome(e){e.preventDefault();caseInput(e);closeCase(false,()=>{$('#top-nav .brand').focus({preventScroll:true});},'#top');}
  $('#csHome').addEventListener('click',returnHome);
  $$('.cs-open').forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.shiftKey||e.altKey)return;if(openCase(Number(link.dataset.case),link,e.detail===0))e.preventDefault();}));
  const initialCase=location.hash.startsWith('#case/')?studies.findIndex(c=>c.id===location.hash.slice(6)):-1;
  if(initialCase>=0)openCase(initialCase,null);

  /* Motion is optional; essential copy and controls are visible by default. */
  const pauseButton=$('#pauseBtn');
  function applyMotion(){
    reduce=motion.matches;body.classList.toggle('paused',paused||reduce);pauseButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(paused));pauseButton.disabled=reduce;$('span',pauseButton).textContent=reduce?'Motion reduced':paused?'Resume motion':'Pause motion';
    lensMotion?.motionChanged();syncMedia();featureInstance?.motionChanged();
  }
  pauseButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{paused=!paused;applyMotion();window.Sfx?.play(paused?'tapeStop':'tapeStart');});motion.addEventListener('change',applyMotion);
  const footer=$('#footer');footer.classList.add('in');
  $('#yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();

  function updateNavigation(){
    const pastHero=scrollY>0||hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom<=nav.getBoundingClientRect().height+32;
    nav.classList.toggle('past-hero',pastHero);
    nav.inert=false;
  }
  new ResizeObserver(updateNavigation).observe(hero);
  function measure(){positionMarker();updateNavigation();}
  let scrollQueued=false;
  function scroll(){scrollQueued=false;const y=scrollY;nav.classList.toggle('solid',y>40);updateNavigation();const r=$('#xpLine').getBoundingClientRect();$('#xpLine').style.setProperty('--tp',String(clamp((innerHeight-r.top)/innerHeight,0,1)));}
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!scrollQueued){scrollQueued=true;requestAnimationFrame(scroll);}},{passive:true});
  addEventListener('resize',()=>{measure();if(innerWidth>760)setMenu(false);});
  body.classList.add('ready');$$('.rv,.card,.xp,.wk-head').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('in'));
  if(!reducedOrPaused()){const reveals=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.remove('motion-pending');reveals.unobserve(entry.target)}}),{rootMargin:'0px 0px -24px 0px',threshold:.04});$$('.card,.rv,.xp').forEach(el=>{if(el.getBoundingClientRect().top>innerHeight){el.classList.add('motion-pending');reveals.observe(el)}});}
  featureInstance=window.PortfolioFeatures.init({data,mountMedia,unmountMedia,openCase,reducedOrPaused,copyMount:$('#footerCopy'),initialProject:0,focusChoices:[{name:"Opening"},...projects],
    selectProject(choice,{commit}={}){const index=choice-1;if(commit)selectedProject=index;showProject(index);}
  });
  applyMotion();measure();scroll();document.fonts?.ready.then(measure).catch(()=>{});
})();

</script>
<script>/* Native buttons own expansion; the panel keeps its existing case-study links. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 if(!document.body.classList.contains('mobile-index'))return;
 const query=matchMedia('(max-width:760px)');
 const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#work .card')];
 let expanded=null;
 function apply(){
  cards.forEach(card=>{
   const button=card.querySelector('.project-toggle');
   const panel=card.querySelector('.project-panel');
   const open=!query.matches||card.id===expanded;
   if(!open&&panel.contains(document.activeElement))button.focus({preventScroll:true});
   card.dataset.expanded=String(open);
   button.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
   panel.inert=!open;
   if(open)panel.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');else panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  });
  document.dispatchEvent(new Event('portfolio:layoutchange'));
 }
 cards.forEach(card=>card.querySelector('.project-toggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  expanded=expanded===card.id?null:card.id;apply();
 }));
 query.addEventListener('change',apply);apply();
})();
</script></body>
</html>
